explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/70: 'Erdős and Rado proved that 𝔠 → (ω+n, 4)³₂ for any 2 ≤ n < ω', where 𝔠 is the order type of the reals. The Lean variant states RealCardinalRamsey3 (ω + n) 4 for n ≥ 2: for every 2-colouring of unordered triples of ℝ (a permutation-invariant predicate on distinct triples), either some order embedding of the ordinal ω + n into ℝ has all triples red, or some 4-element set of reals has all triples blue. This uses the real line's order type as in the source (unlike the omega_three variant). Faithful.
